title: Single-cell imaging of the lytic phage life cycle in bacteria
authors: Wedd C; Li R; Yunusov T; Smith A; Smith A; Hardo G; Hunter M; Mohan AK; Majed R; Fusco D; Bakshi S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究裂解性噬菌体感染细菌的单细胞成像动态，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: When a lytic bacteriophage infects a bacterial cell, it commandeers the cell’s resources to replicate, ultimately causing cell lysis and the release of new virions. As phages function as obligate parasites, each stage of the infection process depends on the physiological parameters of the host cell. Given the inherent physiological variability within a population of genetically identical bacterial cells, we ask how the phage infection dynamic reflects such heterogeneity. Here, we introduce a timelapse imaging assay for investigating the dynamics of individual infection steps by a single T7 phage on a single bacterium. This high-throughput, time-resolved assay enables us to monitor the infection progression simultaneously in multiple cells, uncovering substantial heterogeneity at each step and revealing correlations between infection dynamics and the physiological state of the infected cell. Simulations of competing phage populations with different lysis time distributions reveal that heterogeneity in infection dynamics can significantly impact phage fitness, highlighting it as a potential evolutionary driver of phage-bacteria interactions.
abstract_zh: 当裂解性噬菌体感染细菌细胞时，它会劫持细胞的资源进行复制，最终导致细胞裂解并释放新的病毒粒子。由于噬菌体作为专性寄生生物，感染过程的每个阶段都依赖于宿主细胞的生理参数。鉴于基因相同的细菌群体内部固有的生理变异性，我们探究噬菌体感染动态如何反映这种异质性。在此，我们引入一种延时成像测定法，用于研究单个T7噬菌体对单个细菌的各个感染步骤的动态。这种高通量、时间分辨的测定法使我们能够同时监测多个细胞中的感染进程，揭示每个步骤中的显著异质性，并展示感染动态与受感染细胞生理状态之间的相关性。对不同裂解时间分布的竞争性噬菌体群体的模拟表明，感染动态中的异质性可显著影响噬菌体的适应性，强调其作为噬菌体-细菌相互作用潜在进化驱动因素的重要性。
